Eiffel Tower Staff Strike Over Alleged Sidelining of Female Colleagues

Staff at the Eiffel Tower went on strike, leading to the monument's closure, after female employees were allegedly asked to step aside for a visiting Hindu delegation. Workers and management confirmed the strike, which was prompted by instructions that reportedly led to female staff being "sidelined, replaced and made invisible because of their sex." The visit was organized by the Bochasanwasi Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha (BAPS) spiritual movement. The exact nature of the instructions and the extent of the alleged sidelining remain points of contention.
